players.bio: Amani Tye Louis-Marie Richards is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley.

Arley Wayne Kay (born 15 February 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back or defender for EFL League One club Barnsley. He is widely recognized as one of the club's breakout young talents for the 2026–27 season.

Ben Hamed Touré is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley. On 7 May 2023, Touré made his professional debut for Ajaccio in a 0–0 Ligue 1 draw at home against Toulouse, coming on as a 75th-minute substitute. He made his first professional start in a 3–0 league loss away to Lens on 27 May 2023.

Cameron Alexander McGeehan (born 6 April 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Barnsley. Born in England, he plays for the Northern Ireland national team. McGeehan began his youth career at Fulham before joining Chelsea and later Norwich City.

Cieran Peter Slicker is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Barnsley on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland national team. Beginning his career with Manchester City, he has previously spent time on loan with Rochdale.
Clayton Taylor is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Barnsley.
Connor Patrick O'Riordan (born 19 October 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Barnsley, on loan from EFL Championship side Blackburn Rovers.

Daniel Stendel (born 4 April 1974) is a German professional football manager and former player, who currently is the head coach of EFL League One club Barnsley. Stendel played as a striker in his native Germany, spending most of his playing career with Hannover 96, who he later managed.

Fábio Rúben Soares Jaló is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One side Barnsley. Jaló began playing football in his native Portugal with Benfica, before moving to England with Barnsley in 2019.

Jack Timothy Shepherd (born 24 June 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Barnsley. A ball-playing centre-half, Shepherd played non-League football with Penistone Church, Athersley Recreation and Pontefract Collieries, before turning professional with Barnsley in July 2023.
Jonathan Patrick Richard Bland (born 24 October 2005) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Barnsley. He is a Wales Under-21 international.
Jubril Adesope Okedina is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Barnsley. Born in England, he plays for the Malawi national team.
Kieren James Flavell (born 21 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Barnsley.

Leo Farrell is a 20-year-old English striker who plays as a forward for Barnsley F.C. in EFL League One. Wearing the squad number 39, he is an academy graduate who has been with the club since the age of 10.

Luca John Connell (born 20 April 2001) is an Irish professional footballer. He plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One side Barnsley. He started his senior career with Bolton Wanderers before moving to Celtic, from whom he spent two loan spells at Queen's Park. He has represented the Republic of Ireland at under-17 to under-21 levels.
Luke William Alker is an English footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley.

Makenzie Andrew Kirk is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley, on loan from EFL Championship club for Portsmouth. He is also a Northern Ireland U-19 international. His previous clubs are Heart of Midlothian and he had a spell out on loan at Hamilton Academical.
Patrick Kelly is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Barnsley.

Robson Woodcock is an 18-year-old professional footballer who plays as a left-back for English club Barnsley FC. Originally from Rotherham, the attacking full-back progressed through the Barnsley FC Academy. After making his senior professional debut in an EFL Cup match against Fleetwood Town in August 2025, he signed his first professional contract with the club in the summer of 2026.

Reyes Demar Uriah Cleary (born 13 April 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley. Career Cleary progressed through West Bromwich Albion's academy, and began training with the club's first team in the 2021–22 season after impressive form for the club's under-18 and under-23 teams.
Rogan Lee Ravenhill is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Barnsley.
Sam Rodin Gale (born 1 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back or defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Barnsley.
Emmanuel Tobi Adeyemo is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Barnsley.

Tyrese Yurvencey Noslin is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right midfielder for EFL League One club Barnsley. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team. Noslin was born in Amsterdam in 2002, but moved with his family to Almere at an early age. He grew up in Almere Haven, living with his parents, younger brother, and two sisters.

Vimal Yoganathan (born 13 January 2006) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Barnsley. Vimal is the 2nd player of Sri Lankan Tamil descent to play professionally in England, after Sam Durrant.

Ziyad Larkeche (born 19 September 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Barnsley, on loan from EFL Championship club Queens Park Rangers. Born in Paris, Larkeche played youth football with Paris Saint-Germain and Fulham, before on loan to Barnsley in September 2022.
